title: Amelia says an angel took her to see God and names a rabbi and the Dalai Lama as teachers

tellings.quote: she said she said an angel has taken her to see God she said Gods once or twice um uh in in one point I think she talked about the doy Lama as well

plain: A girl named Amelia, from the American Midwest, said that an angel had taken her to see God once or twice, and she named a rabbi and the Dalai Lama, the Tibetan Buddhist leader, as her teachers. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about children said to read minds, passes this on to Michels as something Amelia told her sometime between 2021 and 2024. She also names a person called Mora as a source.
